title: Anisotropy-mediated stress regulation in Mn-substituted VOPO<sub>4</sub> enables aqueous zinc batteries with long cycle life
abstract: Published online: 04 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74444-8 The structural integrity of layered VOPO4 frameworks critically determines their electrochemical performance in aqueous zinc ion batteries. Herein, the authors use partial metal substitution in VOPO4 to modulate local coordination and mitigate cycling induced stress, enabling enhanced cycling stability.
